then.hypothesis: Chain to OAuth token leakage (observe Location without following outbound). The redirect target is an inert sentinel URL under the reserved .invalid TLD, spelled as a literal rather than the {oob} placeholder: this probe has no out-of-band leg -- it reads the Location header in the very response it asked for -- so there is nothing to call back to and no backend to configure. A registrable-looking but unresolvable target also means any redirect the server issues cannot be meant for a real party.
